videos.subject: Ember the fox introduces herself and the film
videos.description: Ember talks straight to camera about who she is and why the lantern matters, with two b-roll moments from the film.
videos.cta: Watch the full film on YouTube

characters.voice_plan: uploaded ElevenLabs audio matched to the film voice sample

script.text: Hi! I'm Ember. Yes, THE fox with the lantern. No, I did not steal it. Mostly.
script.direction: lean toward camera on 'Mostly', one ear flick

script.text: That night the whole forest went dark. Every firefly. Gone.
So I did what any sensible fox would do. I borrowed the moon's spare light. What happened next... you'll have to watch. Full film on YouTube — bring snacks.
script.direction: proud chin up, then a wink on the last line

script.text: And if the owls ask — you never saw me. Subscribe so you don't miss what I definitely will not be stealing next time.
script.direction: conspiratorial whisper, glance left and right
